mapper.select: SELECT task_accepted.id, task_accepted.type_string, sys_user.username AS username, sys_user.user_id AS user_id, task.task_id, task.task_name, task.type, task.map_server, task.date_range, task.mark_table, task.status, task.audit_feedback FROM task JOIN taskaccepted ON task.task_id = task_accepted.task_id JOIN sys_user ON task_accepted.username = sys_user.username ORDER BY task.status, task.task_id DESC
